model: A reference swap only works in game when the replacement's assets are resident. Helldivers 2 loads an item's generated loadout package when some player carries the item (or level generation places it); a swapped-in item nobody carries shows up missing (for example a purple question-mark pickup or an invisible projectile).

Runtime requests the same package through the game's own reference-counted package system before it writes such a reference, waits until the engine reports it resident, and only then applies the write (status WAITING_FOR_ASSETS while loading, ASSET_UNAVAILABLE if it cannot).
residencyVersusCompatibility: packageDependency answers only whether Runtime can load the assets a reference needs. Whether the game behaves correctly with that reference in that slot is a separate question answered by each domain (for example allow_unverified_reference on pod and mount swaps).

pod_payload_pickup.description: A drop-pod rack slot referencing a pickup from another package.
pod_payload_pickup.basis: Live: the replacement loaded and worked with nobody carrying the donor item (tests D, A, E).

projectile_reference.description: A weapon attack referencing another weapon's projectile.
projectile_reference.basis: Live: the replacement loaded and worked with nobody carrying the donor item (test B).

explosion_reference.description: A terminal action referencing another weapon's explosion.
explosion_reference.basis: Offline: native loader proofs, snapshot residency reads and the packaged-runtime simulation. Uses the same loader path and the same source-weapon packages as the live-proven projectile_reference family; not separately live-tested.

vehicle_mount.description: A vehicle mount referencing another vehicle's mounted weapon.
vehicle_mount.basis: Offline: native loader proofs, snapshot residency reads and the packaged-runtime simulation. Not live-tested; live test C was inconclusive.

liveEvidence.control: Before automatic loading, the reference swaps were valid but produced broken or purple placeholder assets unless some player equipped the donor item; equipping the donor separately made them work.

observations: The SMG-32 Reprimand fired the Talon projectile correctly; visuals and function worked.
The Grenade Box spawned correctly from the MG-43 pod.
Nobody brought or equipped the EAT-700.
The pod spawned a real, usable EAT-700 instead of the purple question-mark placeholder.
The Pelican did not deliver the FRV in this test, so the mount was never observed.
Not evidence for or against package loading; Bastion-cannon-on-FRV mount compatibility is a separate, unverified question.
The Grenade Box payload worked in the landed Resupply pod (all four written slots).
The donor assets loaded correctly; the Resupply operations settled 2/2 applied.
